base: Cinematic documentary film footage, in the style of an archival historical documentary: observational, restrained and serious, naturalistic available light, real-world textures, no stylised or fantasy elements, no on-screen graphics.
technical: Shot on 35mm film with fine organic grain and gentle halation, shallow depth of field, slow deliberate camera movement (slow push-in, slow pan or locked-off), stable and unhurried, 24 fps, 16:9 widescreen, 5 to 8 seconds, a single continuous shot with no cuts.
audio: Audio: generate synchronised natural sound effects and ambience only, recorded like production sound with realistic perspective and room tone, sparse and restrained, matching what is visible on screen.
negative: Exclude: any legible text, captions, subtitles, signs with readable lettering, logos, watermarks, split screens, cartoon or CGI look, recognisable real public figures, close-up faces of identifiable people. Audio exclusions: no music, no musical score, no soundtrack, no singing, no voice-over, no narration, no spoken dialogue, no intelligible speech, no laugh track.

paper.grade: Colour grade: desaturated neutral palette with deep blacks and soft grey highlights, faint cool-grey cast, restrained contrast like scanned archival film, a single warm yellow accent allowed only if it occurs naturally in the scene.

sepia-archive.grade: Colour grade: warm sepia-toned palette with amber highlights and brown-black shadows, slightly faded like aged film stock, soft vignette, subtle dust and scratches.

ocean-chart.grade: Colour grade: cold teal and slate-blue palette with crisp steel-grey midtones and clean deep shadows, calm maritime atmosphere, restrained contrast.
